about: LEN-01 block definition: comment lines of one kind with only blank lines between them form one block, and the blank lines do not count. A 3+3 run across a blank line is 6 lines (red); 2+3 across a blank line is 5 (green); 3+3 split by code is two blocks (green). Doc blocks span blank lines the same way: 6+5 is 11 (red), 5+5 is 10 (green).
